title: Newsdeck Workflows Event
description: Schema for POST /api/workflows. Requires columnId and either item or items.

columnId.description: UUID for the target column. Found in the column settings in the UI.

items.description: Array of news items (batch format). Same structure as item.

extra.description: Extra fields applied to all items in the request. Merged into each item's extra object.

id.description: Source's own ID (optional, not unique). Used for deduplication within a column.

source.description: Source name, e.g. Trafikverket, Polisen, SOS Alarm. Default: workflows.

url.description: Link to source or article. Also accepted as uppercase URL.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-03-23T10:30:00Z. Default: server time.

newsValue.description: News value 1-5. 5 = highest priority (red pulsating frame). Default: 3.

category.description: Event category, e.g. trafikolycka, brand, vagarbete.

severity.description: Severity level - free text string, e.g. Allvarlig. Can be null.

location.description: Geographic information. Stored as-is in JSONB.

name.description: Free-text place name, e.g. E4 vid Rotebro.

county.description: County name in free text, e.g. Stockholms lan.

municipality.description: Municipality name in free text, e.g. Stockholm.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, exactly 2 uppercase letters, e.g. SE.

regionCode.description: SCB county code, exactly 2 digits, e.g. 01 for Stockholm, 24 for Vasterbotten.

municipalityCode.description: SCB municipality code, exactly 4 digits, e.g. 0180 for Stockholm.

coordinates.description: Coordinates as [lat, lon] array, comma-separated string, or {latitude, longitude}/{lat, lng} object. Normalized to [lat, lon] array on ingestion.

extra.description: Optional extra fields for this item.
